text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm baaack! I had myself an<n>amazing time!
choice_data_list: You did so well—and in a G1 race, too!
You did so well—and in a G1 race, too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow... You're smiling from ear to ear,<n>Trainer! I'm
glad I could make ya so<n>happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep runnin' in all these big races<n>and turn
everybody into real happy<n>campers!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Your performance at the NHK Mile<n>Cup was
absolutely stunning!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, thank ya very much! If it's a<n>sprint, you can
believe I'm takin' the<n>number one spot!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If you're looking to be<n>crowned
Umamusume of the Year,<n>you'll first have to claim
the URA<n>award in the sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
However... while the NHK Mile Cup is<n>a G1 race,
only classic-year runners<n>can join.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
The selection for the top sprinter also<n>includes
seasoned senior-year<n>runners. You need to
consider your<n>next moves with that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, I got ya! Seniors, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I wanna race against seniors<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll become the best sprinter there is!<n>And
Umamusume of the Year too, of<n>course!
choice_data_list: Right, let's take on the seniors!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Wait... You're not thinking of<n>becoming the autumn
King of the Mile<n>by winning the Mile Championship,
are you?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship... Now<n>there's a name that
gets my heart<n>thumpin'!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
You'll be up against highly<n>experienced seniors. It
won't be<n>easy to achieve the same results<n>you've
had up until now.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Trainer, how do you intend to tackle<n>this hurdle?

Otonashi is making perfect sense—it<n>will take a lot of
preparation to<n>compete against the seniors on equal
footing.
So in order to build up that<n>experience...
choice_data_list: We'll take on the Unicorn Stakes first.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The Unicorn Stakes? If I do recall,<n>that's a—

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Um... Isn't that a dirt race?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thought so!

If we're looking to gain more practical<n>know-how,
this race fulfills all our<n>needs.

Plus, Taiki Shuttle has what it takes to<n>run on
anything!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No problem! I'm down to give it a go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll run whichever race ya think is<n>best, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Th-that's... simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Despite the steep path ahead, you<n>continue to
press on with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
You've chosen to push her forward,<n>unfettered by
the threat of sand in<n>your eyes or muddy water in
your<n>hair!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... The idea that you've steeled<n>yourself for
such dire straits is truly<n>awe-inspiring!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right! I won't let your sacrifice be<n>in vain,
Trainer!

The conversation has gotten a little<n>out of hand, but
regardless, we have<n>the Unicorn Stakes to prepare
for.
